designationHistory.name: Indiana Dunes National Lakeshore
designationHistory.indexText: Congress authorized the Secretary of the Interior to establish Indiana Dunes National Lakeshore on the southern shore of Lake Michigan.

sources.name: NPS, The National Parks: Index 2012-2016 (Indiana), 'Authorized Nov. 5, 1966'

designationHistory.indexText: Congress renamed Indiana Dunes National Lakeshore as Indiana Dunes National Park in the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2019.

authority.citation: Public Law 116-6, div. E, title I, sec. 115, 133 Stat. 232

designationHistory.note: The section is headed 'Indiana Dunes National Lakeshore retitled'; it replaces 'National Lakeshore' with 'National Park' in the 1966 act.

sources.name: NPS History Collection, Indiana Dunes (establishment dates 1966 and 2019)
